entities.summary: Shi Zhengrong (b. 1963-02-10, Yangzhong) was a military leader or commander of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Yangzhong and Australia. Known in the fields of australia, merchants & economists, oceania.
